description: A proposal for the rehabilitation of the Wilmar Residence and Coach House at 2050 SW Marine Drive — a 1925 Vancouver heritage estate. Soren Rasmussen Architects Inc. appears in the City of Vancouver Heritage Commission agenda of January 2013 in connection with the application.
note: This page is a work in progress: the firm's exact role in the 2013 proposal is unconfirmed, and the estate's later redevelopment (2015 onward) was carried out by another firm and is not SRA's work.
